verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.text: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.html: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.html: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.text: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.html: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.text: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.html: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

verses.html: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.html: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.html: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.html: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.html: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.text: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

verses.html: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.text: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

verses.html: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.text: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
